labels.name: Collagen gene
labels.function: Mutation here gives a structurally abnormal protein

labels.name: Collagen mRNA
labels.function: If unstable, less type III or V product is made

labels.name: Procollagen chain
labels.function: Translated backbone that is processed inside the cell (step 1)

labels.name: Post-translational modification
labels.function: Steps 2-3: processing of the chains before secretion

labels.name: Exocytosis
labels.function: Releases the processed protein outside the cell

labels.name: Cleavage of terminal regions
labels.function: Step 5: removes disulfide-rich ends; affected in EDS

labels.name: Cross-linkage
labels.function: Step 6: joins adjacent molecules; if disturbed, unstable

labels.name: Collagen fiber
labels.function: Final structural form used in skin, bone and vessels

labels.name: Lens
labels.function: Subluxates up and out, causing myopia

labels.name: Palate
labels.function: Highly arched, with crowded teeth and malocclusion

labels.name: Aortic root
labels.function: Progressive dilation; regurgitation, aneurysm, dissection

labels.name: Mitral valve
labels.function: Prolapse with regurgitation; surgery if severe

labels.name: Sternum
labels.function: Sunken (excavatum) or pigeon (carinatum) deformity

labels.name: Pleural cavity
labels.function: Recurrent pneumothorax: air collects here

labels.name: Vertebral column
labels.function: Scoliosis develops; treated by bracing or surgery

labels.name: Abdominal skin
labels.function: Purple striae, as in pregnancy or cortisol excess

labels.name: Acetabulum
labels.function: Protrusio deformity distorts the hip joint

labels.name: Fingers
labels.function: Abnormally long and slender (arachnodactyly)

labels.name: Carotid artery
labels.function: May form a fistula with the cavernous sinus and rupture

labels.name: Aorta
labels.function: Aneurysm, dissection or rupture; shortens lifespan

labels.name: Intestine
labels.function: Can rupture, reflecting type III collagen distribution

labels.name: Uterus
labels.function: Rupture risk in pregnancy and childbirth

labels.name: Skin
labels.function: Stretches over 4 cm; close wounds with multiple sutures

labels.name: Finger joints
labels.function: Hypermobile and prone to frequent dislocation

labels.name: Shin
labels.function: Bluish-grey spongy pseudotumors and hard spheroids

labels.name: Heel
labels.function: Yellow fat protrusions appear here on standing
